Synopsis:
Oil near $100/bbl driven by Middle East escalation (Houthis, Iran, U.S. forces) is weighing on global sentiment ahead of a key U.S. inflation print on Friday and central bank meetings the following week (Fed and BOJ). The yen has surged ~4% in September, squeezing carry trades, with the BOJ widely expected to hike 25bps on Sept 17–18. The dollar is on the back foot but analysts flag that higher oil and yields may limit further USD downside until inflation data provides clearer direction. BNY estimates yen fair value in the 140s, suggesting further yen appreciation is plausible.
